title: Granular slot defragmenter and stable spill handoff for KV cache
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: reduce long-tail latency and memory fragmentation observed on multi-tenant KV cache under mixed sequence-length workloads. This change introduces a lightweight granular slot defragmenter that compacts small free slots within hot segments without global stop-the-world passes and a stable spill handoff mechanism to reduce jitter when multiple tenants trigger spill simultaneously. The defragmenter runs opportunistically during low CPU utilization windows and is placement-aware so it avoids interrupting active continuous batching kernels. The spill handoff guarantees an ordered, per-tenant spill queue that prevents oscillation between eviction and rehydration under bursty workloads. Changes: 1) new slot_defragmenter module that tracks slot usage at ~64B granularity and performs local compaction when free-slot fragmentation exceeds a threshold; 2) soft-quota-aware eviction path that prefers reclaiming subsegment holes before evicting whole entries; 3) stable_spill coordinator that serializes spill initiation per-tenant and provides a backpressure token to the scheduler; 4) small scheduler hook in batch_router so continuous batching kernels can opt-out of compaction windows when latency SLOs are tight; 5) observability additions: metrics for fragmentation_ratio, compaction_cycles, spill_handoff_rate and tenant_spill_latency histogram; 6) integration tests and microbenchmarks comparing end-to-end tail latency and token cost. Commits summary: [a1b2c3d] introduce slot_defragmenter scaffolding and unit tests; [b2c3d4e] implement compaction algorithm and integration with cache allocator; [c3d4e5f] add stable_spill coordinator and per-tenant queues; [d4e5f6a] scheduler hook and continuous-batching opt-out path; [e5f6a7b] docs, metrics, and benchmarks. Files changed (high level): internal/kv/cache/slot_defragmenter.rs - new module with compaction loop and heuristics; internal/kv/allocator/soft_quota_reclaimer.cc - changes to prefer slot coalescing; internal/kv/evictor/stable_spill.go - new coordinator and tests; internal/scheduler/batch_router.cpp - opt-out hook and minor APIs; docs/kv/defrag.md - design notes and operator guidance; tests/kv/defrag_integration_test.go - multi-tenant scenarios; benchmarks/kv/slot_vacancy_bench.yaml - benchmark harness; tools/observability/kv_metrics_exports.yaml - prometheus metric exports. Testing and CI: initial CI run had a flaky integration test related to timing of compaction and continuous batching; flaky test was quarantined and fixed by introducing a deterministic wait in tests and replacing time.Now()-based assertions with logical event markers. All unit, integration, and benchmark CI jobs passed on the final run. Benchmarks: 95th percentile request latency improved by 18% on mixed short/long sequence workloads vs baseline, median cost-per-token reduced by 6% under steady-state due to fewer full-entry evictions. Rollout plan: feature gated behind kv.defrag.enabled false by default. We will rollout to canary tenants for one week with fragmentation_ratio and tenant_spill_latency dashboarding and automatic rollback if tenant_spill_latency increases by >15% for more than 10 minutes. Related work: complements prior slab-based reclaimer work and the soft-spill backpressure PRs; references ENG-6421 and ENG-6590 for backlog context. Changelog: add entry about defragmenter and stable spill coordinator. Merge: squash and merge to main.

review_comments: Ethan Wallace: Nice approach overall. Two requests: 1) please add a safety check to ensure compaction doesn't increase cache-write amplification under pathological workloads, 2) document the expected CPU cost per compaction cycle so SRE can budget it.
Priya Nair: Added amplification metrics and a configurable cpu_budget_pct for the compaction loop. Benchmarks added that show <3% extra CPU under steady-state in our canary tests.

Lucía Márquez: The spill handoff looks good but we need stronger guarantees about ordering during cross-tenant eviction storms. Suggest adding a bounded retry/backoff to the handoff token acquisition to avoid starvation.
Priya Nair: Implemented bounded exponential backoff with a max-wait and added tests to show no tenant starvation in 1000 simulated cycles.
Ahmed El-Sherif: Integration test was flaky initially due to timing; after switching to event markers it's stable. Please also add a brief ops runbook entry.
Priya Nair: Ops runbook added to docs/kv/defrag.md under 'operational notes' with dashboard links and rollback steps.
release_notes: Added a granular slot defragmenter and a stable spill handoff coordinator for the KV cache. This reduces fragmentation-induced evictions and stabilizes spill behavior during tenant bursts resulting in improved tail latency and lower cost-per-token. Feature is gated and disabled by default. See docs/kv/defrag.md for enablement and operational guidance.
